context: Daichi cleans up after the festival with Aoi.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: cleanup chat; vocabulary (鬼/新しく/とら/おっしゃる/剤) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 節分、盛り上がったね!後片付けしよう。
lines.en: Setsubun was lively! Let's clean up.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 床、まだ拭けとらんわ。洗剤あるか?
lines.en: I haven't wiped the floor yet. Got detergent?
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新しい洗剤、買っておいたよ。
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おお、新しく買うてくれたんか、助かるわ。
lines.en: Oh, you bought new ones, that helps.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 鬼のお面、片付けておくね。
lines.en: I'll put away the demon mask.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お客さん、また来たいておっしゃってたで。
lines.en: The customers said they want to come again.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: この洗剤、よく落ちるね!
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: まだ豆、拾いきれとらんけどな!
lines.en: Though I haven't picked up all the beans yet!
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
